senses.gloss:
1 Oneness, unity, harmony;
R. 10. 82; U. 6. 33.
--2
Unanimity.
--3 Identity, sameness.
--4
Especially, the identity of the human
soul or of the universe with the
Deity.
--5 An aggregate, whole.
--6
(In alg.) The product of the
length and depth of the portions
or little excavations differing
in depth (Colebrooke).
